cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
def load(p):
    d={}
    for line in open(p, encoding='utf-8'):
        t,o=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        d[t]=o
    return d
b=load('/tmp/base.txt'); h=load('/tmp/head.txt')
diff=[k for k in b if b[k]!=h[k]]
noB=[k for k in diff if 'B' not in k]
noB_noBrace=[k for k in noB if '{' not in k and '}' not in k]
print("noB diffs:",len(noB)," of which no braces:",len(noB_noBrace))
for k in noB_noBrace[:40]:
    print(f"{k!r}: base={b[k]!r} head={h[k]!r}")
# Also check: all noB diffs contain an unclosed '{' before a known placeholder?
weird=[k for k in noB if '{' not in k]
print("weird (no left brace):",weird[:20])
withB=[k for k in diff if 'B' in k]
# check backslash diffs are even-count before a brace
import re
unexplained=[]
for k in withB:
    # encoded B = backslash
    if not re.search(r'B+(?:\{heal\}|\{level\}|\{zap\})', k):
        unexplained.append(k)
print("B diffs without B-run before placeholder:",len(unexplained))
for k in unexplained[:30]:
    print(f"{k!r}: base={b[k]!r} head={h[k]!r}")
EOF
